Above is my indie game Merri Puzzle on Steam. It is a physics based puzzle game. I saw a lot of people doing roll a ball through a maze, or get to the end of a maze type games. I really loved and enjoyed them as a kid (you would always get these from wendy's or dairy queen. So I decided to make one myself. I had not gone any game dev in YEARS before this, so it was a bit scary. I learned a lot quickly. The best advice I can give to people is take bad criticism, and work from it. You shouldn't have a hissy fit in the comment sections on green light or where ever you are trying to post your game to get it published. Negative comments are better than positive ones as it identifies flaws in your game. My games graphics were not to many peoples liking, so I re-did them 5 times! Eventually I got the votes to get green lit. I have had lack luster sales and success, but the journey was wonderful! I did a huge content update recently as well to address some of the feedback and e-mails I have gotten.

I think the hardest thing for your game is promotion. Indie DB and other sites that do give always help a good amount.
